applies_to: Carrier AquaForce 30XV140-500 Series B variable-speed air-cooled screw chillers with the PIC6.1 Carrier Controller and version 9.x software.
summary: The 30XV Carrier Controller has native BACnet IP on Ethernet-0 (J15) and BACnet MS/TP on RS485-4 (J8), with about 765 objects: AVs, BVs and a few MVs named after their CCN table and point. Commands are separate _rd (read) and _wr (write) objects; the writable copies are BV 123-129 and AV 552-554, plus the setpoint AVs 545-551. Each alarm has its own read-only BV (ALM_...).
notes: Command points have a read object (e.g. BV 6 GENUNIT_CHIL_S_S_rd) and a separate write object (BV 123 GENUNIT_CHIL_S_S_wr).
The table has no units column; temperatures and pressures follow the BACnet Metric Unit setting (bacunit).
Alarm BV descriptions in the table are just the alarm code (e.g. LOW_SUCTION_B_F).
The same manual also has a separate list for the older BACnet/Modbus translator option (Appendix D); this file covers the native BACnet IP and MS/TP list (Appendix E) only.
The table also gives an option type, COV increment and trend log interval, not reproduced here.

source.title: AquaForce 30XV140-500, Series B Variable Speed Air-Cooled Liquid Chillers with Greenspeed Intelligence and Carrier PIC6.1 Controller - Controls, Start-Up, Operation, Service and Troubleshooting (Appendix E, BACnet IP and MS/TP Points)

integration.summary: Enable BACnet (bacena), pick BACnet IP or MS/TP in the BACnet configuration menu, set the identifier and network number, then select the Network machine control method with the Start/Stop button. Command through the _wr objects (start/stop, occupancy, control point, demand limit, emergency stop) and read run status, water temperatures, capacity and alarm state.

minimum_points.name: GENUNIT_CTRL_PNT_wr
minimum_points.why: Leaving water control point from the BMS

minimum_points.name: GENUNIT_CTRL_TYP
minimum_points.why: Control type: Local, Network or Remote

integration.enable: Select the Network machine control method with the Start/Stop button; the unit then follows network commands and ignores the remote control contacts and the Enable-Off-Remote switch (SW1). Start/stop and occupancy are written to the _wr objects. In Local On, Local Schedule or Remote the unit ignores network commands except emergency stop.
integration.heartbeat: The manual says that if communication with the network is lost while under network control, the machine starts and is controlled locally.
setup: BACnet is enabled with the bacena service parameter; the data link (bacdlink) defaults to BACnet IP and can be set to MS/TP.
Defaults shown: network 1601, identifier 1600001, BBMD/foreign device off (0 = none, 1 = FD, 2 = BBMD).
MS/TP defaults: MAC 1, 38400 baud (9600-115200), Max Master 3, Max Info Frames 5.
BACnet IP uses Ethernet-0 (J15); BACnet MS/TP uses RS485-4 (J8).
gotchas: Write the _wr object, not the _rd one; the _rd copy only reports the current value.
Cooling setpoints (AV 545-547) and switch limit setpoints (AV 549-551) are also writable directly, besides the GENUNIT _wr commands.
AV 109 ALARMRST_ALM and MV 109 Alarm_State share instance 109 but are different object types.
